title: The School Ghost
lines: Kim went to a school that was very old.
Kids said a ghost lived in the halls.
At night it made a long, sad sound.
It went up and down like a song.
The cook said it was just a machine.
But Kim did not think that was it.
"Can we go and look?" she said to Mom.
That night Mom got a lamp and they went in.
The dark hall felt still, and Kim led the way.
They stood and did not hear a thing.
Kim felt so sad. "It has gone," she said.
Then the sad sound came again.
It came from a door at the back.
Kim gave the door a hard tug.
It did not open. The door was stuck.
So she got a stick and tugged again.
The door came free. Green eyes shone!
It was a cat, stuck in there since lunch.
Mom held the lamp and Kim fed it milk.
Her school ghost sat and ate and shut its eyes.

questions.ask: What did the kids say lived in the school?
questions.listenFor: A ghost, in the halls. Line two says it.

questions.ask: What was really making the sad sound?
questions.listenFor: A cat, stuck in back of a door since lunch. The cook had guessed a machine.

questions.ask: What would you take with you to look? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Kim took a lamp and her mom.
